content.title: Texas Rangers 2026 Home Opener: How to watch and what to look for
content.text: Published April 3, 2026 11:55am CDT ARLINGTON, Texas - Baseball returns to Arlington in just a matter of hours. It’s opening day for the Texas Rangers! Rangers Home Opener The Rangers will face the Cincinnati Reds in their first game of the 2026 season at home. Texas had a strong start on the road with a 4-2 record on the season so far. Their six-game road trip was to Philadelphia and Baltimore. Friday’s home opener starts at 3:05 p.m. How to watch the Texas Rangers game WHAT: Texas Rangers (4-2) vs Cincinnati Reds (3-3) WHEN: Friday, April 3, 2026 | 3:05 PM CST WHERE: Globe Life Field | Arlington, Texas HOW TO WATCH: MLB Network, MLB Extra Innings, Fubo, MLB.TV, Victory+ Globe Life Field Roof Officials at Globe Life Field confirmed on social media that the roof will remain closed for the 3 p.m. game. That’s because scattered showers and thunderstorms are in the forecast for Dallas-Fort Worth on Friday afternoon. According to the FOX 4 Weather team, storm coverage will increase Friday evening with some storms becoming strong to severe. Starting Lineup PHILADELPHIA, PENNSYLVANIA - MARCH 29: MacKenzie Gore #1 of the Texas Rangers throws a pitch in the first inning during a game against the Philadelphia Phillies at Citizens Bank Park on March 29, 2026 in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. (Photo by Hunter M Mackenzie Gore will take the mound for Texas. Gore, who was traded to the Rangers in January, made a strong debut against the Phillies, earning a win with 7 strikeouts and a 3.38 earned run average over 5 innings. Other players in the starting lineup include Brandon Nimmo, Wyatt Langford, Corey Seager, Jake Burger, Joc Pederson, Josh Smith, Josh Jung, Evan Carter, and Danny Jansen. First Pitch and National Anthem Stars goalie and Olympic gold medalist Jake Oettinger will throw out the ceremonial first pitch. Neal McCoy will be signing the national anthem. Globe Life Field Menu Highlights Rangers Home Opener | The Ten The Ten takes Steve Noviello and Paige Ellenberger out to the old ballgame. They try out some ballpark foods and talk a bit of baseball. The Rangers will have a bevy of new food and drink items for fans to enjoy this season at Globe Life Field. Highlights include the 9th Inning Rally Sombrero, a giant nine-layer dip served in a fried tortilla shell, and the Pig Kahuna, a pork sandwich topped with pineapple and peanut butter sauce. The Texas Ribeye Sandwich features grilled Nolan Ryan Beef ribeye steak topped with chimichurri, sliced tomato, and fresh arugula on a soft roll, served with French fries. And the Texas Tenderloin Sandwich is Nolan Ryan Beef tenderloin served on a brioche bun with gouda cheese, dijonnaise and balsamic dressed arugula, served with French fries.
